description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for verifying the functionality of Git's HTTP backend, specifically focusing on aliasing and protocol version handling for upload-pack and receive-pack commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that output is empty, indicating no errors.

methods.name: test_tool pkt-line unpack
methods.description: Unpacks packet lines from Git protocol output for comparison.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit in the repository.
